bugs.name: The empty address-book message misspells “addresses” as “adresses”.
bugs.summary: The empty address-book message misspells “addresses” as “adresses”.
bugs.actual: The visible message says “adresses added to his address book.”
reproSteps: Sign in as the fixture Saleor admin and create a disposable customer without sending an invitation.
Open the customer record, select Address Information > Manage, and read the empty Address Book message.

bugs.name: Delete Address confirmation has a possessive typo in its explanatory copy
bugs.summary: Delete Address confirmation has a possessive typo in its explanatory copy
bugs.expected: The confirmation message should use grammatically correct possessive wording, such as “the user's address book.”
bugs.actual: The dialog says, “Are you sure you want to delete this address from users address book?”; “users” is missing a possessive apostrophe (or determiner).
reproSteps: /customers/
Sign in to the dashboard as an administrator and create a fresh customer with a saved address.
Open that customer's address book, open the saved address's More menu, and choose Delete Address.
Read the confirmation dialog message.

bugs.name: Customer profile says no addresses when saved address exists in the address book
bugs.summary: The customer profile continues to say “This customer has no addresses yet” after a saved address is visible in that customer’s address book, including after refreshing the profile.
bugs.expected: After saving an address in the customer's address book, the profile's Address Information should reflect the address or at least not state that the customer has no addresses.
bugs.actual: The address book visibly listed Taylor Example at 741 Test Boulevard, San Francisco, CA, but the profile's Address Information continued to display “This customer has no addresses yet” after returning to the profile and refreshing it.
reproSteps: Load the provided authenticated administrator session (admin@example.com; no credentials entered) and open /customers/?asc=true&sort=name.

Choose Create customer. Create a fresh customer named “Momentic Address Summary 20260604 Isolated QA” with email “momentic+address-summary-20260604-a91f@usemomentic.com”; leave all Primary Address fields blank and save. The profile opens at /customers/VXNlcjo1Nw%3D%3D and initially says “This customer has no addresses yet.”
On the new customer profile, choose Manage in Address Information, then choose Add address.

Enter Taylor Example, company “Momentic Address QA 20260604,” street “741 Test Boulevard,” city “San Francisco,” postal code “94105,” country “United States of America,” and region “California”; save the address.
Confirm the address is listed in the address book at /customers/VXNlcjo1Nw%3D%3D/addresses.
Use the Customer back control to return to the profile and inspect Address Information; it still says “This customer has no addresses yet.”
Refresh /customers/VXNlcjo1Nw%3D%3D and inspect Address Information again; the same empty-state message remains.

bugs.name: Type-specific customer creation omits required attributes and saves an invalid customer
bugs.summary: Creating a customer under a type with required attributes succeeds without those attributes, then ordinary editing fails because required values are missing.
bugs.expected: Customer creation exposes and enforces the customer type's required attributes before saving.
bugs.actual: The create form has no QA Loyalty Tier control and saves successfully. The created customer's required attribute is blank. Saving a note subsequently fails with This field is required and Attribute expects a value but none were given.
reproSteps: Sign in and open Configuration > Customer attributes.
Create a required dropdown attribute such as QA Loyalty Tier with a value.
Assign the attribute to a customer type such as QA Wholesale Updated.
Open Customers, select that type's tab, and click Create QA Wholesale Updated.
Enter first name, last name, and a unique email, then click Save.
On the created customer detail, change only Note and click Save.

reviewedVariants.name: Typed customer creation omits required attributes and creates an invalid customer
reviewedVariants.summary: Create Customer for a customer type does not expose its required attributes. It accepts the customer without them, then ordinary edits fail because those values are required.
reviewedVariants.expected: Typed customer creation should display and validate required attributes before saving, allowing users to create a valid customer.
reviewedVariants.actual: For QA Alt 0553 Type with required dropdown QA loyalty level 0553, the create form contains only contact, primary address, and notes. Contact-only creation succeeds. On the new detail page the required attribute is blank; changing Note and saving produces 'This field is required' and 'Attribute expects a value but none were given.' Selecting a dropdown choice allows the edit to save. Reproduced with two customers.
reproSteps: Open customer types and create a test type, QA Alt 0553 Type.
Assign a dropdown attribute, QA loyalty level 0553, with Gold/Silver/Bronze choices and Value Required enabled.
Open Customers, select that type's tab, and click Create QA Alt 0553 Type.
Observe the create form has no Attributes section. Enter first name, last name and a unique email, then Save.
Creation succeeds. Open the resulting customer, change Note and Save.
Observe the blank loyalty dropdown is now marked required and the save fails with 'Attribute expects a value but none were given.'
Select a loyalty choice and Save; the customer update succeeds. Repeat contact-only creation to reproduce (qa.required0556@example.com, customer51, remains blank for inspection).
